column1: # Package install commands, ONE definition shared by the launcher (scripts/lib/detect.sh)
# and the wizard (setup/src/system.ts). Format, one row per line:
# and must match on both sides; the test in setup/tests/system.test.ts asserts that.
#   * commands are repo data — no user-supplied value is ever interpolated into one;
#   * they run through `sh -c` (or `sudo sh -c`), so they are written as shell;
#     `--no-cache`) because the wizard must never block on a package manager prompt;
#   * only packages whose names are stable across the family live here. Docker is
#     deliberately absent: the only reliable cross-distro path is Docker's own
#     repository/installer, so it is reported with instructions instead of being
#     installed with a guessed package name (see setup/src/system.ts).
# Distro Node is often older than engines.node (Debian 12 ships 18, Ubuntu 24.04
# ships 18): the launcher tries nvm first and re-checks the version afterwards.
# Informational: only needed to run the local worker outside Compose. The worker image
# builds and pins its own FFmpeg (transcoding/toolchain/), and the Modal pipeline
# brings its own, so an installed host FFmpeg is never what produces the output.
